title: homalium cordylanthus
intro: Homalium cordylanthus, commonly known as African dogwood, is a plant species in the family Salicaceae. It has been traditionally used in African folk medicine to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, including its potential to lower blood pressure, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Homalium cordylanthus include its ability to modulate inflammation, exhibit antioxidant activity, and display immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
